'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Winston Plunkett LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Winston Plunkett]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Hokey Religions
* '''Username:''' Winston P
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
